name: Applied AI training data API
description: Read-only copies of public Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) tables for the Day 3 data website lab. Free, no key, and readable from any web page (CORS open). Each dataset comes as JSON (with its source, notes and column descriptions) and as CSV.
license_note: Data from the Philippine Statistics Authority. Cite PSA as the source on anything you publish.

datasets.title: Population and annual growth rate, by region, province, city, and municipality
datasets.source: PSA OpenSTAT, Population and Annual Population Growth Rate of the Philippines and its Regions, Provinces, and Highly Urbanized Cities Based on the 2010, 2015, 2020 and 2024 Population Census

datasets.title: Poverty incidence among population, by region, province, and highly urbanized city
datasets.source: PSA OpenSTAT, Table 2a. Annual Per Capita Poverty Threshold and Poverty Incidence Among Population with Measures of Precision, by Region, Province and Highly Urbanized Cities: 2018, 2021, and 2023

datasets.title: Retail prices of rice per kilogram, monthly
datasets.source: PSA OpenSTAT, Cereals: Retail Prices of Agricultural Commodities by Geolocation, Commodity, Year and Period (2018-based, new geographic code)

datasets.title: Inflation rate (year-on-year change of the Consumer Price Index), monthly
datasets.source: PSA OpenSTAT, Year-on-Year Changes of the Consumer Price Index in Percent by Commodity Group (2018=100)
